nonIndexablePagesDetail: Pages that exist in dist but are deliberately absent from site-urls.txt and the sitemap: 22 x 404 (root + 21 non-English locales) + 1 Netlify forms placeholder (/__forms). Invariant checked in verify-baseline: htmlTotal - site-urls.txt lines === this number. Update it deliberately, with a reason, when the set changes (e.g. English-only posts add 21 fallback shims each, which do stay out of the list).
updateReason: Adds four English-only regulatory posts (FDA 510(k) vs EU MDR, IEC 62471 photobiological safety, IPL device EMC testing, IPL labeling and claims) ahead of their 21-locale translations, on top of the 15-post B2B batch already declared. Measured effect of these four: htmlTotal 3763 -> 3851 (4 real pages + 84 shims), nonIndexablePages 338 -> 422, sitemapCanonicalMismatch 315 -> 399, blogPerLocale 92 -> 96 in every locale because the shims are counted as blog pages in dist. site-urls.txt gains 4 lines only. Backfill removes 21 shims per translated post.
